text: dsh-conversation-jump 是面向 DSH Web 的对话导航插件，在 Web 客户端挂载一组悬浮圆形按钮，帮助用户按自己的消息浏览长对话。它提供回到顶部、上一条用户消息、下一条用户消息和回到底部操作；向前浏览时，如果目标还未加载，会自动请求更早的历史，并跳过工具调用等非用户消息。导航条会随向上快速滚动出现，并在停止使用后隐藏。适合需要在长会话中快速回看自己提问的 DSH Web 用户。代码未声明额外 API key 或外部服务要求。

dsh-conversation-jump adds a floating navigation rail to DSH Web. Buttons jump to the top or bottom and move between user messages, skipping tool entries. It loads older history when needed and suits users revisiting questions in long chats. No API key or external service is declared.
想在很长的 DSH 对话里快速找到我之前问过的问题。
DSH 能不能让我按用户消息逐条往前或往后跳？
Help me jump between my questions in a long DSH Web chat.
dsh-conversation-jump 的功能「按用户消息导航」：对话右侧悬浮导航条提供上一条、下一条以及顶部和底部跳转；点击前后消息按钮会将对应用户或 steering 消息定位到视口锚点。
dsh-conversation-jump 的功能「自动加载更早历史」：点击上一条消息时，如果目标不在当前已加载内容中，插件会调用对话的加载更早按钮并持续翻页，找到可定位的消息后跳转。
dsh-conversation-jump 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 25 天；提交数 17；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

English | [中文](#中文)

A rail of four circular buttons for the DSH Web conversation: **to top**, **previous user message**, **next user message**, **to bottom**. It floats above the composer at the right edge of the conversation, and replaces the product's single built-in "to bottom" button.

dsh-conversation-jump README · What makes it different：Sibling plugins mostly draw a **minimap**, a **table of contents**, or **inline anchors**. This one does none of that. It steps through the conversation **one user message at a time** — a click lands exactly on the previous or next thing *you* asked — and pages older history in automatically when the target sits outside the loaded window.

dsh-conversation-jump README · What makes it different：Navigation targets are only `user` and `steering` entries. Tool calls, context injections, compaction markers and other process nodes are skipped, so "previous" means "my previous question", not "the previous DOM block".

A rebuild alone does not reach the running page. Re-run the `dsh plugin … add file:…` command after each build (or copy the built file into that package) and then reload the page.

text:
dsh-conversation-jump README · Capabilities：| Capability | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| To top | Scrolls to the current top, then keeps paging older history in until the real top is reached |
| Previous | Jumps to the previous user message; if it lies beyond the loaded window, it pages older history in — as many pages as it takes — until that message is loaded |
| Next | Jumps to the next user message |
| To bottom | Goes straight to the newest position |
| Message anchor | The target message settles about `1/12` down from the top of the viewport |
| When it appears | Hidden by default; appears when the average upward scroll speed exceeds `200 px/s`, hides again as soon as you scroll down yourself |
| Auto-hide | Disappears `3 s` after appearing; clicking any button or hovering the rail restarts that countdown |
| Position | Aligned to the right edge of the conversation and `16 px` above the composer, positioned synchronously before paint so it does not flash |
| State | Page-memory only — nothing persisted |

dsh-conversation-jump README · Capabilities：Button labels are Chinese (`回到顶部` / `上一个` / `下一个` / `回到底部`); each button carries the same text as both its `title` and `aria-label`, and the rail is a `role="toolbar"` labelled `会话导航`.

dsh-conversation-jump README · Implementation notes：- **Targeting is attribute-based, not hash-based.** The scrollport is `[data-conversation-scroll]`, user messages are `[data-chat-anchor-key]` filtered by `data-chat-flow-kind`, and the composer seat is `[data-composer-seat]`. The built-in "to bottom" button is hidden by matching the stable `_toBottomSlot` class **suffix** rather than a CSS-module hash, so a DSH upgrade that rehashes class names does not break it.
- **Paging drives the product's own control.** It locates the "load older" button inside `[data-chat-flow]` — the first button that is not inside a message row and precedes the first row — clicks it, then polls the anchor count until it grows. Attempts are bounded, so a host that never grows the list cannot spin forever.
- **One "previous" click keeps paging until it reaches a user message.** The host pages older history by *node* count (50 per request) while a single agent turn regularly spans more than that, so a page that adds no user message at all is normal — and a freshly opened session can even load a window that holds no user message at all. Landing right after such a page would put the view back where it started

dsh-conversation-jump README · Boundaries：- This is a **Web UI plugin only**. The host half (`index.mjs`) is an empty `apply` — no host services, events, tools or storage.
- It keeps **page-memory state only**: no `localStorage`, IndexedDB, cookies, files or backend database.
- If the host never renders a "load older" button, paging cannot proceed and the jump stops there rather than looping.

text:
dsh-conversation-jump README · 能力：| 能力 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 回到顶部 | 先滚到当前顶部，再持续翻页加载更早历史，直到真正的顶部 |
| 上一个 | 跳到上一条用户消息；若它在已加载窗口之外，会持续翻页（需要几页就翻几页）直到该消息被加载出来 |
| 下一个 | 跳到下一条用户消息 |
| 回到底部 | 直接到最新位置 |
| 消息锚点 | 目标消息停在视口上方约 `1/12` 处 |
| 显示策略 | 默认隐藏；往上平均速度超过 `200 px/s` 时显示，读者自己往下滚动时立即隐藏 |
| 自动隐藏 | 出现后 `3 秒`无操作自动消失；点击任一按钮或把指针停在导航条上会重新计时 |
| 定位 | 对齐对话内容右缘、输入框上方 `16 px`；绘制前同步定位以避免闪动 |
| 状态 | 仅页面内存状态，不做持久化 |

dsh-conversation-jump README · 实现说明：- **定位基于数据属性而非哈希类名。** 滚动容器是 `[data-conversation-scroll]`，用户消息是 `[data-chat-anchor-key]` 并按 `data-chat-flow-kind` 过滤，输入区是 `[data-composer-seat]`。产品自带的“回到底部”按钮通过匹配稳定的 `_toBottomSlot` 类名**后缀**隐藏，而不是写死 CSS-module 哈希，因此 DSH 升级重新生成类名不会失效。
- **翻页走产品自身的控件。** 在 `[data-chat-flow]` 中定位“加载更早”按钮（第一个不在消息行内、且位于首行之前的按钮）并点击它，然后轮询锚点数量直到增长；尝试次数有上限，宿主始终不增长列表时也不会空转。
- **一次「上一个」会一直翻到真正出现用户消息为止。** 宿主按**节点数**翻页（每次 50 个），而一个 agent 轮次往往远超这个数，所以“翻了一页但没有新增任何用户消息”是常态；刚打开的会话甚至可能整个已加载窗口里一条用户消息都没有。若翻完一页就落地，视图会回到原处；而窗口里一条用户消息都没有时，旧版在发出任何请求之前就结束了这一步，按钮等于完全没反应。因此插件会持续请求，直到已加载窗口头部之前出现用户消息（上限 40 页），再落到该消息上。
- **宿主的翻页控件只有一条通道。** 它自己的请求在飞行中时该按钮是 disabled 的（显示「加载中…」），而插件翻页时占用同一条通道。落在这个窗口里的点击会等待通道空闲后再执行，而不是被丢弃；「上一个」也会取代正在进行的「回到顶部」翻页，而不是被它吞掉。
- **只注入 `slots` 一个席位。** `cordis-plugin-timer` 是纯 Host 服务，在 Web 端不存在，因此插件声明 `inject: ['slots']` 并使用原生 `setTimeout` / `setInterval`，同时记录每个句柄以便卸载时取消。
- **样式会自愈。** 样式挂在 fiber 拥有的 `<style data-dsh-conversation-nav>` 节点上，但每 100ms 采样都会检查它是否还在，缺失就重新创建。因此当 fiber 被重新 apply 而移除样式时（例如 dev 模式下 HMR 重建本插件），不会出现“导航条仍挂着却变成页面左上角的无样式按钮、产品自带『回到底部』同时回来”的状态——下一个采样周期就恢复，不需要刷新页面。
- **卸载时全部清理**：样式元素、所有待执行定时器、滚动监听。

dsh-conversation-jump README · 边界：- 这是**纯 Web UI 插件**。Host 半边（`index.mjs`）是空的 `apply`——不需要 Host 服务、事件、工具或存储。
- 只维护**页面内存状态**：不使用 `localStorage`、IndexedDB、Cookie、文件或后端数据库。
- 若宿主始终没有渲染“加载更早”按钮，翻页无法进行，跳转会就此停止，不会死循环。
